senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
श्यै to go, डुणाक aff.

m. (-तः)
A sack, a coarse canvas bag.
E.
षिव to sew, क्त aff., यूच् substituted for the finals, and the vowel changed; also स्यूत.

m. (-नः)
1 The sun.
2 A ray of light.
3 A coarse canvas bag or sack.
n. (-नं)
Happiness, pleasure.
E.
षिव to sew, Uṇādi aff. न, and यूच् substituted for the radical finals, and the vowel changed.
